content.rendered:
“17. And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine? 19. And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole”
Luke 17 vs. 17, 19

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotionals today.

When the Samaritan leper came back to thank Jesus, Jesus said, “thy faith hath made thee whole”. Jesus pronounced wholeness upon the grateful leper. Nine other lepers also got healed, but Jesus sealed the miracle of the Samaritan leper when he came to give thanks.

Friend, put on the garment of gratitude. Show God gratitude for everything He has done for you; show Him gratitude for uncommon miracles you received in 2015; thank Him for protocols He broke for you; show gratitude for higher levels; seal your testimonies with gratitude.

Jesus expected gratitude from the ten lepers, and when only one returned, He asked, “but where are the nine”? God expects your display of gratitude; for every divine intervention you have received this year, show God gratitude. Gratitude is the seal on your miracles; gratitude is a debt you owe God.

Jesus pronounced wholeness upon the leper who came back with gratitude; He completed what He began when He saw gratitude. Your gratitude will push God to complete what He Started.

Start your show of gratitude right away. Don’t be like the nine lepers who walked away with incomplete packages. Show God gratitude and He will perfect His work in your life.
Pray With Me: Lord, I’m grateful for everything You have done and begun in me, in Jesus’ name.

Enjoy A Super Sunday.
